  <bpmn:process id="account-closure" name="Account Closure" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Closure requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="receive_final_statement_ack" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="receive_final_statement_ack" name="Await final statement acknowledgement" messageRef="Message_FinalStatementAcked">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="receive_final_statement_ack" targetRef="gw_closure_route" />
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="gw_closure_route" name="Closure route">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="gw_closure_route" targetRef="catch_client_confirms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="gw_closure_route" targetRef="timer_auto_close" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_client_confirms" name="Client confirms closure">
      <bpmn:incoming>f3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="catch_client_confirms_def" messageRef="Message_ClosureConfirmed" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="catch_client_confirms" targetRef="end_confirmed" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="timer_auto_close" name="Auto-close window">
      <bpmn:incoming>f4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="timer_auto_close_def">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="timer_auto_close" targetRef="end_auto_closed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_confirmed" name="Closed (client confirmed)">
      <bpmn:incoming>f5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_auto_closed" name="Closed (auto)">
      <bpmn:incoming>f6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=accountId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>

    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=accountId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>

  <bpmn:process id="base-rate-change-broadcast" name="Base Rate Change Broadcast" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Rate change confirmed by treasury">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="gw_fan_out" />
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="gw_fan_out" name="Affected product families">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_mortgages</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_personal_loans</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_savings</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_mortgages" sourceRef="gw_fan_out" targetRef="svc_flag_mortgages" name="Mortgages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=affectsMortgages</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_personal_loans" sourceRef="gw_fan_out" targetRef="svc_flag_personal_loans" name="Personal loans">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=affectsPersonalLoans</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_savings" sourceRef="gw_fan_out" targetRef="svc_flag_savings" name="Savings">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=affectsSavings</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_flag_mortgages" name="Flag mortgage book">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="flag-product-book" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_mortgages</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_flag_personal_loans" name="Flag personal-loan book">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="flag-product-book" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_personal_loans</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_j2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_flag_savings" name="Flag savings book">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="flag-product-book" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_savings</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_j3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="gw_join" name="Join">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_j2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_j3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_j4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_j1" sourceRef="svc_flag_mortgages" targetRef="gw_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_j2" sourceRef="svc_flag_personal_loans" targetRef="gw_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_j3" sourceRef="svc_flag_savings" targetRef="gw_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_j4" sourceRef="gw_join" targetRef="throw_broadcast" />
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="throw_broadcast" name="Broadcast rate change">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_j4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="throw_broadcast_def" signalRef="Signal_BaseRateChanged" />
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="throw_broadcast" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Broadcast complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="end_def" />
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_BaseRateChanged" name="BaseRateChanged" />
</bpmn:definitions>

    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0" id="Definitions_P04" targetNamespace="http://northwind-private-bank.example.com/bpmn" exporter="northwind-reference-app" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:process id="sanctions-screening" name="Sanctions Screening" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Screening requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="svc_screen" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_screen" name="Screen against sanctions/PEP lists">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="screen-sanctions-pep" retries="3" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="svc_screen" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_list_updated" name="Sanctions list updated">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="catch_list_updated_def" signalRef="Signal_SanctionsListUpdated" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="catch_list_updated" targetRef="svc_rescreen" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_rescreen" name="Re-screen applicant">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="rescreen-sanctions-pep" retries="3" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>f5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="svc_rescreen" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:startEvent id="timer_periodic_rescreen" name="Every 6 hours">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="timer_periodic_rescreen_def">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT6H</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="timer_periodic_rescreen" targetRef="svc_rescreen" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Screening complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>f4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_SanctionsListUpdated" name="SanctionsListUpdated" />
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0" id="Definitions_P07" targetNamespace="http://northwind-private-bank.example.com/bpmn" exporter="northwind-reference-app" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ClientResponded" name="ClientResponded">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=applicationId" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:message>
  <bpmn:process id="underwriting-review" name="Underwriting Review" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Case ready for review">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="ut_first_review" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="ut_first_review" name="Underwriter review">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:userTask />
        <zeebe:assignmentDefinition assignee="=caseOwnerUserId" candidateGroups="underwriters" />
        <zeebe:taskSchedule dueDate="=now() + duration("P2D")" followUpDate="=now() + duration("P1D")" />
        <zeebe:priorityDefinition priority="70" />
        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="underwriting-first-review-form" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="ut_first_review" targetRef="gw_four_eyes" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_four_eyes" name="Needs second sign-off?" default="f_single_signoff">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_needs_second</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f_single_signoff</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_needs_second" sourceRef="gw_four_eyes" targetRef="ut_second_review" name="Over threshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=requestedAmount > 250000</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_single_signoff" sourceRef="gw_four_eyes" targetRef="gw_wait_outcome" name="Under threshold" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="ut_second_review" name="Second underwriter sign-off">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:userTask />
        <zeebe:assignmentDefinition candidateGroups="senior-underwriters" />
        <zeebe:priorityDefinition priority="80" />
        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="underwriting-second-review-form" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f_needs_second</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="ut_second_review" targetRef="gw_wait_outcome" />
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="gw_wait_outcome" name="Wait for outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>f_single_signoff</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>f3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="gw_wait_outcome" targetRef="catch_client_response" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="gw_wait_outcome" targetRef="timer_sla" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="catch_client_response" name="Client responds">
      <bpmn:incoming>f4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="catch_client_response_def" messageRef="Message_ClientResponded" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="catch_client_response" targetRef="end_decided" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="timer_sla" name="SLA window">
      <bpmn:incoming>f5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="timer_sla_def">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT48H</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="timer_sla" targetRef="svc_escalate_sla_breach" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_escalate_sla_breach" name="Escalate SLA breach">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="escalate-sla-breach" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="svc_escalate_sla_breach" targetRef="end_sla_breach" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_decided" name="Decision recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>f6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_sla_breach" name="SLA breached">
      <bpmn:incoming>f8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="boundary_case_sla" name="Case SLA expired" attachedToRef="ut_first_review">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="boundary_case_sla_def">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P5D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="svc_case_sla_breach" name="Handle case SLA breach">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="handle-case-sla-breach" />
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>f9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="boundary_case_sla" targetRef="svc_case_sla_breach" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_case_sla" name="Case SLA breach handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>f10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="svc_case_sla_breach" targetRef="end_case_sla" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
